# Mohammad Moin

> Independent Consultant and Corporate Trainer, based in Bengaluru, India (IST, UTC+5:30). 14+ years of production engineering underpins both practices: hands-on client delivery in React, Angular, Vue and Node.js, and enterprise technical upskilling for teams at IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP, and Dell. Remote-based, open to cross-timezone teams.

## Who this is
Mohammad Moin works at the intersection of building and teaching. As an independent consultant, he delivers production web and mobile applications end to end — architecture through deployment. As a corporate trainer, he designs and runs technical upskilling programs for enterprise engineering teams, and has trained 15,000+ engineers across 350+ sessions.

## Consulting
- Full-stack web and mobile delivery for clients, working remotely and asynchronously with distributed teams
- Recent engagement: React Consultant, JLL (Jan 2024 – Mar 2025) — re-architected legacy AEM/Java web components to React within a 10-15 engineer team spanning multiple countries; orchestrated a shared SolidJS design system translated into React and Angular
- See: https://mdmoin7.github.io/portfolio/consulting/

## Training
- Enterprise upskilling for cohorts of 20-50 engineers, each with 5+ years' experience, with repeat engagements from returning clients
- Clients: IBM, Amazon, Walmart, SAP, Dell
- Curricula authored: React & NestJS Intermediate Track (40h, API-first), Angular Intermediate Track (40h + optional Day 6 on NgRx/micro-frontends), React JS Development Track (40h, capstone-based), GenAI-Powered .NET Application Development (reference course)
- See: https://mdmoin7.github.io/portfolio/training/
